inventario.sql: select a.codigo as "código", a.nombre as "articulo", c.nombre as "categoria", a.precio_a as "precio a", a.precio_b as "precio b", a.precio_c as "precio c", a.precio_d as "precio d", coalesce(sum(e.cantidad), 0) as "existencia" from TABLA_ARTICULOS a left join TABLA_CATEGORIAS c on c.id = a.categoria_id left join TABLA_EXISTENCIAS e on e.articulo_id = a.id where a.activo group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7

facturas.sql: select f.numero as "num factura", to_char(f.fecha, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "fecha", to_char(f.fecha, 'HH24:MI') as "hora", f.total as "total", f.subtotal as "subtotal", cl.nombre as "cliente", cl.telefono as "telefono", a.nombre as "producto", d.cantidad as "cantidad", d.precio as "precio", b.nombre as "local" from TABLA_FACTURAS f join TABLA_DETALLE d on d.factura_id = f.id join TABLA_ARTICULOS a on a.id = d.articulo_id left join TABLA_CLIENTES cl on cl.id = f.cliente_id left join TABLA_BODEGAS b on b.id = f.bodega_id where f.fecha >= {desde} and not f.anulada
